notes.title: Frost Bound Selected for BIC 2025!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hello Lords,[/b][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that [i]Frost Bound[/i] has been officially selected for the [b]Busan Indie Connect Festival (BIC) 2025[/b]! 🏆[/p][p]Starting with [b]Demo Day[/b] on [b]July 14th[/b], the BIC 2025 lineup will be revealed to the world — and [i]Frost Bound[/i] is among the chosen few.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/784b7037c6d4752fad5552b208fb447d3e6fdf7a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Join us and experience our latest demo:
[b]Online:[/b] August 8 – August 29 → [url="https://www.bicfest.org"]www.bicfest.org[/url]
[b]Offline:[/b] August 15 – August 17 at [b]BEXCO, Busan[/b][/p][p]We’re honored to stand beside so many amazing indie games and can’t wait to share what we’ve been working on.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Spread the Word, Earn Your Glory[/h3][p]We invite you to celebrate this milestone with us — share your excitement on social media, tag [b]@BIC_Festival[/b], and help rally more Lords to our cause![/p][p]Stay warm, stay vigilant — the frostbound wilds hold many secrets yet to be revealed.[/p][p][i]Frost Bound[/i] Team[/p]

notes.title: Summer Expo Updates! Join Discord to Stay in the Loop for Beta Opportunities!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Lords, greetings to all![/p][p][/p][p]The summer sale is coming to an end—what great games did you pick up during the event? Feel free to share your favorites in the comments and join the discussion with other players![/p][p][/p][p]Recently, our studio has been working hard on the development of the full version of FrostBound, while also preparing for upcoming closed beta recruitment. The day when we can meet you with the official release and beta testing is drawing closer! [b]If you want to be among the first to get the latest updates and not miss any beta opportunities, please join our [/b][url="https://discord.com/invite/RrU7ZXxSPX"]Discord[/url] to connect with fellow Lords and become a veteran member there![/p][p][/p][p]With summer underway, many expo events are taking place. Although we didn’t participate in the recently concluded CCG Expo or this week’s Bilibili World, our team will be bringing FrostBound to meet players at upcoming events. Check out our exhibition schedule and be sure to come say hi when we’re there![/p][p][/p][h3]BitSummit the 13th Summer of Yokai[/h3][list][*][p]Event Date: July 18–20, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]Location: Miyako Messe, Kyoto, Japan[/p][/*][*][p]Booth: 1F-D12[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/796a603dbfc0e4fbcf7f21f748f89bf029988240.png"][/img][/p][h3]ComiDay29[/h3][list][*][p]Event Date: July 19–20, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]Location: New Century Global Center, Chengdu, China[/p][/*][*][p]Booth: Hall 8, Indie Game Area, A22[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/d10ac5b9f054ebb531e89b41bb1dcd83b24df598.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]PG Indie Game Expo & The 24th Beijing IJOY International Animation & Game Festival[/h3][list][*][p]Event Date: July 26–27, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]Location: National Convention Center, Beijing, China[/p][/*][*][p]Booth: PG·01[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/f81da23e1bfb8f9a5c26cb41ffe6248cdf8f5d4f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]2025 ChinaJoy Express Game Demo Zone[/h3][list][*][p]Event Date: August 1–4, 2025[/p][/*][*][p]Location: National Convention Center, Beijing, China[/p][/*][*][p]Booth: N1 · CJE01[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/96cfd27d792932614384bbddbc0d16d9760c011f.png"][/img][/p][p]Finally, a friendly reminder: be sure to join our community—if you miss the closed beta recruitment, you’ll have to wait for the official release! Also, don’t forget to [b]add FrostBound to your wishlist[/b]. Your support means a lot to us and helps us continue improving the game! [/p][p]Thank you all, Lords, for your ongoing attention and support. Wishing you a fun-filled summer gaming season—see you in the comments![/p]

notes.title: Our game FrostBound has surpassed 10,000 demo players in just one month!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/cefde0c3747e7491eb03748e0d185ba354ae4362.jpg"][/img][/p][p]This is a milestone we never dared to imagine when we first started development. We're incredibly grateful for all the support and encouragement from our amazing community.[/p][p][/p][p]To all the new players joining us—welcome! We hope you enjoy diving into our fresh take on the roguelike deck-building genre.[/p]

notes.title: FrostBound Steam Next Fest Recap and Feedback
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Lords![/p][p][/p][p]First off, a heartfelt thank-you to everyone who has supported FrostBound! Thanks to your enthusiasm, the game maintained a [b]90% "Very Positive" rating[/b] even after the Next Fest ended! To be honest, the response far exceeded our expectations. As our very first title, receiving this much attention and feedback has given our team tremendous confidence and motivation to keep pushing forward.[/p][p][/p][p]With Steam Next Fest now behind us, development on the demo will temporarily pause as our team shifts focus entirely to preparing content for the full version set to launch later this year.[/p][p][/p][p]In the meantime, we’ve gathered some fun stats and stories from the frontlines that we’d like to share. Also, we’ll be addressing some of the most frequently asked questions and concerns raised during the demo—including plans for the official release—at the end of this post. Now, let’s take a look at the latest battle reports from the front![/p][p][/p][h2]FrostBound: Next Fest Battle Report[/h2][list][*][p]During Next Fest, lords held the frontlines for a total of [b]95,638 days![/b][/p][/*][*][p]There were [b]5,340[/b] blood-soaked battles that reached the fifth-to-last day boss fight—only[b] 411 [/b]were cleared on the first attempt. Lords who managed a first-try victory are true masters of the deck![/p][/*][*][p]A total of [b]4,297 [/b]hidden boss battles were triggered on the fourth-to-last day, with[b] 2,817[/b] ending in victory. Let’s congratulate the lords who emerged triumphant![/p][/*][*][p]Thanks to its efficient search and cost-reduction synergy, [b]Overload/Overload+[/b] was chosen a whopping [b]6,873 [/b]times—making it the most-picked card of the entire demo. Meanwhile, the once-reigning supplier, [i]First-Gen Pick King[/i], was dethroned due to rising costs.[/p][/*][*][p]Supports come and go, but the most popular elite remains [b]Celestia[/b]—summoned [b]4,893 [/b]times by lords seeking her powerful aid.[/p][/*][*][p]Other popular elites include [b]Helene[/b], [b]Astanor[/b], and [b]Qionghua[/b]. Together with [b]Celestia[/b], they form the four leading elites of the major factions.[/p][/*][*][p]The top three elites warming the bench are [b]Beiluo[/b], [b]Soul Reaver[/b], and [b]Remin[/b]—not because lords dislike them, but simply because they’re hard to draw…[/p][/*][*][p]Stone Golem was summoned [b]1,419[/b] times, making [b]Klem[/b] the most frequently included boss battle special card. By comparison, the [b]Exile Cannon[/b] was snatched in only [b]8 [/b]battles.[/p][/*][*][p]The Night Market was chosen [b]7,299[/b] times, securing its spot as the top building—proof that even in the apocalypse, lords still know how to make a profit. Meanwhile, [b]Barricade[/b] and [b]Grimholt[/b] rose as the fan-favorite legendary buildings thanks to their straightforward, powerful effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Curse? Blessing! A total of [b]7,171 Curse of Greed[/b] following Irrigation System joined the lords’ decks.[/p][/*][*][p]Hero [b]Aurethil[/b] was the most picked at the start, followed by [b]Anduriel[/b]—the only hero with a permanent reputation boost mechanic, and [b]Fate[/b]—favored for its strong ranged adaptability.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Player Feedback Q&A and Official Release Plans[/h2][p]Since the demo launch, we have received a total of 301 survey responses. We have carefully read every single one. Below are answers to some of the most frequently asked questions.[/p][p][/p][h2]Game Release Date and Pricing, Supported Platforms, and Steam Workshop Support[/h2][list][*][p]The full version is planned to launch before [b]October 2025![/b] Honestly, the great attention from all of you has raised our expectations for the final product. Completing the full content in less than four months is indeed a tight schedule, but we’re committed to doing our utmost to avoid any delays. Please stay tuned for our official release date announcements.[/p][/*][*][p]The game’s official price has not been set yet. Once we finalize the release schedule, we will share a definite number with you. Our goal is to offer a fun, affordable experience with plenty of content to enjoy.[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding support for the Steam Workshop, we’ve heard your strong interest loud and clear. To be honest, our team currently doesn’t have the capacity to explore its feasibility, as our main focus is on developing the full version. So, we can’t make any promises right now, but please know that we will seriously consider it.[/p][/*][*][p]Regarding multi-platform and controller support, the game will initially [b]launch on PC[/b]. A Mac version is planned but, due to tight development schedules, it may be added via an update after release. We also plan to port the game to consoles like Xbox in the future. A mobile version is currently not confirmed. As for [b]controller support[/b], gamepad support is planned, while keyboard support is still uncertain. Final details will be confirmed with the full release.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Regarding Game Performance[/h2][list][*][p]Among all art-related feedback, the UI received the most comments. We will prioritize optimizing it in the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]We have carefully received all feedback regarding loading screens, font sizes, special effects, card readability, battlefield scenes, and other details. We will strive to optimize these aspects without compromising the completion and quality of the full version. With only one artist on our team who is already working extremely hard, we can’t promise perfection, but the final release will be the result of our utmost effort. We sincerely thank all lords for your understanding and support.[/p][/*][*][p]The game’s music in the demo is still a temporary version. In the full release, both music and sound effects will be enhanced to provide a richer and more immersive experience.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Regarding Game Content[/h2][list][*][p]Regarding concerns about game content volume, the 70% mentioned when players completed the demo refers to a [b]single playthrough’s progress[/b]—specifically, completing 10 out of the last 13 days. This percentage does not include events, unreleased cards, heroes, and other content. In fact, the demo’s total content is well below 70%. We believe the full version will deliver a fresher and richer experience for everyone.[/p][/*][*][p]The full version will feature [b]difficulty tiers[/b], aiming to ensure both new and veteran lords can enjoy the game. The demo’s difficulty can’t be simply classified into a single level; we will adjust the difficulty curve based on your test feedback and collected data.[/p][/*][*][p]Some buffs and mechanics were only lightly touched on in the demo. In the full version, we will deliver richer mechanic experiences and more intense battlefield dynamics.[/p][/*][*][p]The demo’s tutorial has many rough or missing parts. We will focus on improving this aspect in the full version.[/p][/*][*][p]Many lords have expressed the wish to bring their favorite cards into battle. We plan to incorporate card-locking and related mechanics to make this possible.[/p][/*][*][p]The game’s story is only a glimpse beneath the surface in the demo. In the full version, we will enrich it through event narratives and more, delivering the complete [i]FrostBound[/i] saga—letting you experience the joys, sorrows, and legends that unfold across this land.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]That wraps up our full recap and feedback from this Next Fest. Once again, thank you to every lord for your support of [i]FrostBound[/i]. We also hope that those who enjoy our game will help spread the word—it truly means a lot to us![/p][p][/p][p]Keep Up with Us on Social Media:[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/RrU7ZXxSPX"]Discord[/url][/p][p][url="https://x.com/lyrastudiogames"]x[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.youtube.com/@PlayFrostBound"]Youtube[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61577092110005"]Facebook[/url][/p]

notes.title: FrostBound Confirmed for June Steam Next Fest
notes.notes: [p]Dear Players！[/p][p][/p][p]We’re thrilled to announce that FrostBound will be participating in the upcoming June [b]Steam Next Fest![/b] Since the May Demo launch, our game’s median playtime has reached [b]1 hour and 11 minutes[/b], with the average playtime hitting an impressive [b]3 hours and 40 minutes![/b] We’re excited for every player who’s immersed themselves in the game, and we sincerely thank everyone for their feedback—it’s driving us to continually improve and push forward![/p][p][/p][p]If this is your first time trying FrostBound, don’t worry! It’s an [b]easy-to-learn, hard-to-master[/b] roguelike deck-building card game. Let me explain its rules to you in [b]5 simple sentences[/b].[/p][olist][*][p]In the game, you play as a lord defending against disasters amid an endless winter. Each run gives you 3 Integrity points (health). Failing a regular battle costs you 1 point (we’ve kindly given you three chances!), but losing a boss fight will immediately end your run.[/p][/*][*][p]Your battlefield is a 7-column grid, with 6 columns available for deployment. If any enemy crosses your leftmost defense line, the battle ends in failure (See? I told you it’s simple).[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/21aec2558dee616040302ffe4ef417d53e0f8d31.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]You’ve got plenty of ways to fight! The game offers Attack cards that deal direct damage to cards on the field, Defense cards that can be deployed in your lanes or neutral lanes, and Skill cards with various unique mechanics to build your deck. On top of that, powerful Structure cards (think of them like Relics in other card games) provide unexpected support.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/e7f82677a56ea945ae31592fe7488e1b7f1aa526.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Each disaster monster has health, defense, and even ranged attack and magic power. You’ll need to develop strategies based on their unique traits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/beb1f1d67ee8bdc8ec075b16e8369ebc3d2e4db7.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Keep in mind that due to the freezing weather, regular defensive warriors will retreat after one turn. Only sturdy structures and steadfast elite units can withstand the harsh cold and hold the battlefield.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592692/24a0614bc6fa1e8652a6aefc13f2399f1bc0714c.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/olist][p]Now, you’re ready to become a lord! It’s time to defend your own territory. Add FrostBound to your wishlist now, and start building your unique deck in the Demo![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3649580/FrostBound/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: FrostBound Demo - Patch-Note
notes.notes:
Dear Lords,

Over the past 10 days of the demo, we've received an overwhelming amount of support and feedback. We'd like to express our gratitude to every player who participated in the demo!
One of the most important feedbacks is that the [b][i]attack card[/i][/b] experience in the original version is not good. Cards other than elite cards often perform poorly. Based on these two points, we have made major updates by [i][b]merging Morale and Armament[/b][/i]. Now, the growth of attack cards can keep pace with the game's progression.
We've also implemented numerous content optimizations and updates. Here are the details:

[h2]System and Mechanism Adjustments[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Merged Morale and Armament: Each point of Armament now increases both attack and defense card values by 1.
[*] Introduced Card Pack System: Card packs will be unlocked gradually as the game progresses.
[*] Implemented Card Locking Feature: Now players can lock specific cards to prevent them from appearing in the game.
[*] Adjust the appearance logic of all battles to make the experience of different battles smoother.
[*] Improved Boss Fights: Increased interaction space against Boss.
[*] Added "Aranya" Buff: The next melee attack will deal 1 damage to both sides.
[*] Added "Relinquishment" Buff: Attack card is not affected by Armament.
[/olist]

[h2]Balance Adjustments and Content Optimizations[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Redesigned Herald's Mechanic.
[*] Buffed Aurethil, slightly nerfed Anduriel, slightly buffed Order.
[*] Adjusted Balance of some Axiom and unconventional cards.
[*] Buffed faction-related Runes.
[*] Redesigned the Overworld's Visuals.
[*] Increased the Number of Playable Cards in the demo.
[*] Added 2 New Epic Events.
[*] Optimized the VFX of Epic Card Icons, improving the visual distinction of facilities.
[*] Upgraded the Visual Quality of Enemy Cards.
[*] Refined Descriptions of most cards.
[*] Enhanced rich text on cards.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed the Bug where elite cards could repeatedly appear or be duplicated.
[*] Added Sound Settings: Resolved the bug where some buttons on the main page didn't function after adjusting settings.
[/olist]

As a test version, we acknowledge there are still many issues to discover and resolve. We are so grateful for your support and feedback!
Enjoy the game!

LyraStudio

P.S. Join our [b]Discord[/b] to communicate about everything in the game at any time. To keep up with all the latest updates, don't forget to follow us on social media:

notes.title: FrostBound Demo - Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hey, everyone！

We are thrilled to announce that the free demo of [b][i]FrostBound[/i][/b] is [b]available NOW[/b]！
The [b]full version[/b] of the game will be released in [b]2025[/b]!

[h2]What is [i][b]FrostBound[/b][/i]？[/h2]
[b][i]FrostBound [/i][/b]is a blend of [b]deckbuilding[/b], [b]rogue-like[/b], and [b]tower defense[/b] gameplay set in an endless, frozen winter. Take command as you build your garrison, explore the snowy wilderness, gather vital resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies.

⏩Monsters are assaulting from the right, we must not let them [b]cross the last line of our defense[/b]!
⚔️Explore, collect, build, and [b]unify your powerful forces[/b]!
🃏[b]Over 300 cards[/b] are available for exploration in the demo to create your own deck!
🚩Unique [b]Elite Cards[/b] will become your indispensable assistant!
📝As a lord, every day you must [b]make decisions[/b] to develop and expand your garrison!
⏰In the last [b]13 days[/b] of civilization, uncover the truth about the world!

[h2]What is included in the demo?[/h2]
In the demo, you can experience the content [b]from the 13th to the 4th day[/b] by the descent of calamity, including [b]2 levels of boss battles[/b] and [b]2 special battles[/b]. 
We have opened [b]60% of the cards[/b] and [b]30% of the events[/b], and moreover [b]5 powerful heroes[/b] will join the game following your command...
Want to know more? Open the game and try it out!

Join our [b]Discord[/b] to communicate about everything in the game at any time. To keep up with all the latest updates, don't forget to follow us on social media:
